fragment.claim_boundary: Selecting a publication unit is not remote evidence and is not an AGI claim.
observations: The implementation unit is mechanically complete locally.
Remote publication is the next falsifiable boundary.
Primary ownership and PR 258 remain explicit exclusions.

local_learn.reason: Publication is a concrete external-side-effect unit governed by existing branch isolation and journal contracts; no Root prompt change is supported.

evidence_needed: A fresh main fetch and changed-file comparison showing no overlap with primary work
A durable invocation-journal/idempotency record for the intended branch and PR publication
A remote secondary branch whose exact head equals the locally published head
A single isolated pull request targeting main and excluding primary-owned state
Exact-head CI association or an explicit pending/failed result without rerunning or cancelling primary workflows
expected_outputs: Committed native O Run, invocation, Episode, Candidate-trial, and publication-intent records
Remote branch work/secondary-parallel-writer-v1 with verified exact head
One non-draft secondary pull request and its URL/head SHA
Publication evidence retained for the next Task Evaluate cycle
falsification_boundaries: Stop publication if latest main or PR 258 now overlaps the implementation files.
Stop after any remote branch or PR readback mismatch instead of retrying an ambiguous side effect.
Do not merge, force-push, rerun, cancel, update, or comment on PR 258.
Do not claim exact-head CI success until the check suite reports success for the unchanged secondary head.
result.goal: Persist this secondary native O cycle and publish only the isolated secondary branch and pull request, with fresh-main overlap checks, an idempotency record, exact remote-head readback, and no mutation of primary PR 258 or its lease/run.
inputs: Latest remote main SHA and current PR 258 changed-file/head state
result.parent_continuation: After publication evidence is available, return to Task Evaluate; original genuine-AGI objective remains FAIL regardless of this bounded publication unit.
